what: Tapestry owns Coach and Kate Spade, two American accessible-luxury handbag and accessories brands. Coach provides the large majority of profit and has been growing strongly with younger customers.
customers: Handbag and accessories buyers worldwide, especially in North America, China and Japan, across its own stores, outlets and online.
moat: Coach's brand has been successfully repositioned to attract a younger customer, with direct control over stores and pricing that stops discounting from eroding it.
risks: Kate Spade has been shrinking and needs a turnaround
Chinese consumer demand for accessible luxury has been uneven
Its attempt to buy Capri was blocked by regulators
opportunities: Revenue grew about 14% last year with a 78% gross margin
Return on invested capital of 34% is very high for a consumer brand
Analysts see about 29% upside from current levels
watch: Coach revenue growth and new customer acquisition, and Kate Spade's trajectory.
